The '''Durollia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durollia]].

==History==
The Durollia system was explored sometime between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] to the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]]. It fell into the area of space known as the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]].

==Inhabitants==
By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the Durollia system boasted a population of several million [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].
